primary_purpose: Systematic, source-backed classification of research-eligible ETF structures into the five preregistered confirmatory subtypes without curated allowlist dependency.

source_hierarchy.name: VERIFIED_REGISTRY_SUBTYPE_OVERRIDE
source_hierarchy.description: Point-in-time verified physical grantor trusts allowlist and verified statutory UIT index allowlists with immutable prospectus provenance.

source_hierarchy.name: STRUCTURED_REGULATORY_HOLDINGS_AND_MANDATES
source_hierarchy.description: Quarterly N-PORT portfolio holdings value weights (Treasury, agency, corporate debt, common equity) and Form N-CEN Item C.3.b Index Fund flags.

source_hierarchy.name: STRUCTURED_PROVIDER_CATEGORY_TAXONOMY
source_hierarchy.description: Independent, authoritative third-party fund category classifications (e.g. Morningstar Category, CRSP, Bloomberg Industry Classification System).

source_hierarchy.name: FAIL_CLOSED_UNRESOLVED_SUBTYPE_QUARANTINE
source_hierarchy.description: Instruments lacking authoritative portfolio or category evidence remain UNRESOLVED / PENDING_SYSTEMATIC_CLASSIFICATION and are barred from confirmatory candidate pool.

source_hierarchy.name: EVALUATED_EXPLORATORY_ASSIGNMENT
source_hierarchy.description: Instruments affirmatively evaluated and proven to follow non-confirmatory mandates (multi-asset, active equity, covered call, thematic, crypto, leveraged/inverse) receive OTHER_ETF / EXPLORATORY_ONLY.

portfolio_exposure_metrics.equity_common_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in common stock
portfolio_exposure_metrics.equity_preferred_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in preferred stock
portfolio_exposure_metrics.us_treasury_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in U.S. Treasury bills, notes, bonds, and TIPS
portfolio_exposure_metrics.us_agency_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in U.S. government agency securities
portfolio_exposure_metrics.corporate_debt_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in corporate debt obligations (investment-grade and high-yield)
portfolio_exposure_metrics.mortgage_backed_pct: Percentage of portfolio net assets invested in agency/non-agency mortgage-backed securities and asset-backed securities
portfolio_exposure_metrics.physical_precious_metal_pct: Percentage of net assets represented by physical allocated bullion holdings in custody
portfolio_exposure_metrics.is_index_fund: Form N-CEN Item C.3.b affirmation that fund is an index fund tracking a designated securities index
portfolio_exposure_metrics.is_single_sector_concentrated: Determination that >= 80% of equity exposure is concentrated in a single GICS/ICB sector

FIXED_INCOME_CREDIT.mixed_aggregate_portfolio_policy: Aggregate bond funds (e.g. AGG, BND) containing >=50% government/agency debt and <50% corporate credit fail the pure credit threshold and must NOT be classified as FIXED_INCOME_CREDIT unless explicitly covered by a dedicated aggregate bond research subtype.
